name: SAMPLE machine: one-shot sampler for samples on the +Drive (Cycles One-Shot 0.10)
description: Plays a sample from the +Drive once per trig: 6-tap polyphase at 96 kHz, the stock decimator, the amp chain set up like TONE, then the Model:Samples' filter. The sample is chosen in the PRESET browser and saved with the sound; the main screen shows the pattern's number, the track's number and level, the sample's name and its waveform.

uses.why: the browser reads the opened file: a sample file on a SAMPLE track names the sample instead
sound to record, version 2: the sample's key into record slots 24..27
record to sound: the key back
the screen's redraw, about 30 Hz: loads and frees samples
MainScreenView's draw method: the waveform on a SAMPLE track

formatters.why: an interface object has one formatter, and object 53 is also SNARE's SWEEP: smp_fmt_cutoff falls back to the stock one off SAMPLE's tracks and is put in only while the stock one is there (machine/view.c)

emulation.status: not measured with mcengine.py; One-Shot's README states about 800 instructions per track and block for the filter alone

changes: the filter runs inside the machine, before Volume + Dist; the Model:Samples has it after
unchanged: at Cutoff 0 the track is untouched bit for bit
presets on other machines load as before

conflicts_declared.why: plays sample files from the same browser and needs Model-TG

emulation.tool: digiemu; tools/emu/test_compose.py (Unicorn, the OS's own code, notes/60 §14)
emulation.build: the composed object registered by the registrar runtime, alone (as the web flasher builds it) and with refmachine and refmachine2: the composed 0.9, run by the maintainer, ALL OK (notes/60 §15); the composed 0.10, ALL OK on 2026-10-25 (§16)

hardware.build: One-Shot 0.10's own build (the same code without CM_SYMBOLS), 2026-10-25, as One-Shot 0.9's on 2026-10-24; for 0.8, SAMPLE alone as the web flasher builds it (notes/60 §13) and as machine 6 next to refmachine (the pair, notes/60 §12), 2026-10-22; the composed 0.10 flashed from the web flasher, 2026-10-25 (notes/60 §17); the composed 0.9 never flashed (§15)
